locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure, zero extension, and the source-limit normalization
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, retained inside the combined Weil matrix before every pencil, pullback, resolvent, determinant, coefficient, or inertia operation
locked_conventions.complete_matrix: Q=Q_pole-Q_arch-Q_prime in the explicit source-block notation; equivalently signed Q_arch and Q_prime contributions may be added only when their source signs are already included
locked_conventions.archimedean_erratum: the duplicated c(L) in source equation (4.14) is removed exactly as required by P0_SOURCE_LOCK.json
locked_conventions.source_normalization: 4*hat(k_lambda^+) tends to Xi; unit-normalizing h_lambda is rejected
locked_conventions.boundary_normalization: division by <eta,x> is permitted only after its nonvanishing is established, and every arbitrary ground-line scaling is tracked
locked_conventions.prolate_evenization: no finite-lambda inversion evenness is assumed before the physical arithmetic state is explicitly evenized
locked_conventions.finite_status: all tilt, jet, Weyl, coefficient-cone, and shifted-reserve identities are finite exact reductions and are not asymptotic sign or determinant-limit claims

locked_domains.ground_transform: the complete source matrix has a simple inversion-even full ground x with c=<eta,x>!=0 and T_-=Q_- -epsilon*I>0
locked_domains.fixed_height: sigma is fixed with 0<sigma<1/2 and alpha=sigma*L/(2*pi)
locked_domains.anchor_overlap: <kappa,xi>!=0 is required for w=xi/<kappa,xi>; it follows under B=A-U*I>0 with U>=mu but is explicit for a standalone finite pair
locked_domains.comparison_transform: K_sigma=hat(kappa)(i*sigma)!=0 is required; eventual nonvanishing follows from locally uniform projected-prolate convergence, but is explicit for a standalone finite pair
locked_domains.jet_leverage: U>=mu and B=A-U*I>0 are required before defining E_U, L_0(U), and L_J(U)
locked_domains.weyl_scalar_collapse: A-s*I, Q_- -s*I, and Q_+ -s*I are invertible for the resolvent scalar collapse; the stated projective limits handle an even pole separately
locked_domains.weyl_determinants: alpha_s requires Q_- -s*I invertible; h_s requires Q_- -s*I and Q_+ -s*I invertible; m_s requires Q_+ -s*I invertible but does not require A-s*I invertible; mathfrak_D_s is first derived when A-s*I, Q_- -s*I, and Q_+ -s*I are all invertible and extends through an even eigenvalue when A-s*I and Q_- -s*I remain invertible
locked_domains.weyl_spectral_shift: A-U*I>0 and Q_- -U*I>0 are required, and the logarithmic derivative and integral are used only for real s<=U
locked_domains.schur_derivative: d_s'=-||w_s||^2 is asserted for real s where A-s*I is invertible; the comparison interval s<=U is covered by A-U*I>0
locked_domains.coefficient_cone: epsilon is the simple lowest even-compression eigenvalue and c=<eta,x>!=0, x_0=<V_0,x>!=0
locked_domains.shifted_reserve: the all-axis sign A_x(alpha)>0, a unit representative x, epsilon<=U<lambda_min(A), g_+=lambda_min(A)-U>0, and the Schur-surplus hypotheses are separate inputs

locked_formulas.projective_wronskian: W_sigma(kappa,w)=K_sigma*dot(M_sigma)-dot(K_sigma)*M_sigma=-J_sigma(z_mu), and W/(K_sigma*M_sigma) is invariant under nonzero rescaling of either line
locked_formulas.jet_leverage: |Z_sigma|^2<=E_U*L_0(U), |J_sigma(z_mu)|^2<=E_U*L_J(U); reserves E_U*L_0<=eta^2*|K_sigma|^2 and E_U*L_J<=C_J^2*|K_sigma|^4 bound d_eff
locked_formulas.quotient_reconstruction: for any onto source synthesis W, (A-U*I)^(-1)=W*(W^*(A-U*I)*W)^dagger*W^* after quotienting ker(W)
locked_formulas.positive_ground_countermodel: for N>=2, x=(3/4)e_0^++(sqrt(2)/8)e_1^+, X has diagonal (3/4,2^2,...,N^2), A_N(a)=(a^2+3/4)/(a^2+1), and 9/16*I<T_-<9/4*I; only in the regime alpha->infinity and N/alpha^2->infinity does d_eff=sigma*L/4-1/2+o(1)
locked_formulas.coefficient_response: for x/c=sum_(n=-N)^N xi_n*V_n, xi_0+2*sum_(n=1)^N xi_n=1 and A_x(alpha)=1-2*sum_(n=1)^N n^2*xi_n/(n^2+alpha^2)
locked_formulas.coefficient_polynomial: P_x(s)=product_(n=1)^N(s+n^2)*A_x(sqrt(s))=det(X+s*I)=sum_(j=0)^N p_j*s^j, with e_r(E)=0 when r exceeds the cardinality of E
locked_formulas.coefficient_affine_formula: p_N=1 and p_j=e_(N-j)(E_N)-2*sum_(n=1)^N n^2*xi_n*e_(N-1-j)(E_N without n^2) for 0<=j<N
locked_formulas.coefficient_homogeneous_formula: p_j=e_(N-j)(E_N)*xi_0+2*sum_(n=1)^N e_(N-j)(E_N without n^2)*xi_n and p_0=(N!)^2*xi_0
locked_formulas.coefficient_cone_equivalence: under the simple even-compression ground and c,x_0 nonvanishing hypotheses, Q_- -epsilon*I>0 iff every eigenvalue of X is positive iff A_x(alpha)>0 for all alpha>=0 iff p_j>0 for every 0<=j<=N
locked_formulas.alternating_coefficient_counterexample: for N=2, (xi_0,xi_1,xi_2)=(3,-11,10) has boundary sum one but F(theta)=3-22*cos(theta)+20*cos(2*theta)=-801/40 at cos(theta)=11/40
locked_formulas.weyl_spectral_shift: d/ds log|mathfrak_D_s|=Tr((Q_- -s*I)^(-1))-Tr((A-s*I)^(-1)), integrated from minus infinity with determinant ratio tending to one
locked_formulas.n1_weyl_obstruction: for 0<t<1, Q_+=diag(0,1), Q_-=[1], and kappa_t=t*V_0+sqrt(1-t^2)*e_1^+, one has A=[t^2], residual=t*sqrt(1-t^2), and mathfrak_D_0=-t^2
locked_formulas.pencil_radius_bound: M_2=2*sum_(n=1)^N n^2*|xi_n| and lambda_max(X)<=N^2+M_2; if R>N^2 and 2*sum n^2*|xi_n|/(R-n^2)<1 then lambda_max(X)<R
locked_formulas.shifted_odd_reserve: for a unit representative x, lambda_min(Q_- -epsilon*I)>=g_e*|x_0|^2/(N^2+M_2)
